reasoning_content: Python3 isn't available, so I'll extract the cookie value directly from the appsettings.json file using sed or awk instead.

action.command: cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web && COOKIE=$(sed -n 's/.*"AuthCookie": "\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' appsettings.json); echo "cookie=$COOKIE"; echo "=== /app with admin cookie ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/home2.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" -H "Cookie: bovis_auth_cookie=$COOKIE" "http://localhost:5195/app"; grep -o -E "(Liste der Dienste|Administrationsrechten|edit_html|edit_bl|edit_sel)" /tmp/home2.html | sort -u; echo "=== body of /app with cookie ==="; sed -n '/<body/,/<\/body>/p' /tmp/home2.html | head -40
